creator: Paramanu Sarkar

visual_review.description: Actual weathered rock painting with surviving reddish procession figures visible against textured rock. Natural loss and irregular surface retained; no synthetic reconstruction, annotations or visible watermark. Full frame useful; do not digitally redraw/restore absent figures or present as complete mural.
visual_review.alt: Reddish painted figures survive on the rough rock surface at Sitabinji.
visual_review.caption: The surviving mural at Sitabinji, photographed by Paramanu Sarkar in October2019.
